en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.431 - Sama’a ibn Mehran asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about a man who dies and is only accompanied by women.
Imam (as) replied: "A woman who is his mahram (close relative) should wash him, and the other women should pour water over him without removing his clothes.
If it is a woman who dies among men, with no women or mahram present, She should be buried as She is in her clothing.
If a mahram is present, he may wash her from over her clothes."
